enriched_description: Lightweight athletic footwear designed for running, featuring a cushioned midsole, flexible outsole, and breathable upper. Upper is constructed from engineered mesh or synthetic knit with reinforced overlays at high-stress areas. Midsole uses EVA foam or gel cushioning technology, 2-4 cm thick, with visible air units or gel pods in some models. Outsole features a tread pattern of rubber lugs or waffle grips for traction. Heel counter provides rearfoot stability. Overall weight 200-300 grams per shoe. Distinguishing features include mesh breathable upper, thick cushioned midsole, and specialized running tread pattern.

Heavy-duty secure storage container constructed from thick steel walls (5-15 mm) with a reinforced door and locking mechanism. Rectangular box shape, dimensions ranging from 30 x 30 x 30 cm (personal) to 100 x 60 x 60 cm (commercial). Door features a combination dial, electronic keypad, or key lock with multiple locking bolts extending into the frame. Interior contains shelves or compartments. Exterior is painted gray, black, or beige with a smooth finish. Weight ranges from 20 to 500+ kg. Distinguishing features include thick steel construction, multi-bolt locking system, and combination or electronic access mechanism.

Metal fastening device consisting of a wire pin bent into a clasp shape with a coiled spring at one end and a protective guard (catch) at the other. Total length 2-8 cm depending on size. Wire is steel with a nickel, brass, or zinc plating giving a silver or gold metallic finish. The pin point retracts into the guard when closed, preventing accidental puncture. Spring coil provides tension to keep the clasp closed. Distinguishing features include coiled spring hinge, protective guard enclosure, and wire-clasp fastening geometry.

Small container for dispensing salt, consisting of a cylindrical or bulbous body with a perforated metal or plastic top. Body is constructed from glass, ceramic, plastic, or stainless steel, 5-12 cm tall. Perforated top features a pattern of small holes (typically 3-12) arranged in a circular or decorative pattern. Cap may be screw-on, snap-on, or hinged. Glass variants are transparent, revealing white granular contents. Ceramic variants feature glazed finishes in solid colors or patterns. Distinguishing features include perforated dispensing top, small tabletop scale, and transparent or decorative body.

Open footwear consisting of a sole (rubber, leather, or synthetic) secured to the foot by straps passing over the instep, around the ankle, or between the toes. Sole is flat or slightly contoured, 1-3 cm thick, with a textured footbed surface. Straps are leather, fabric, rubber, or synthetic webbing, arranged in various configurations (thong, slide, gladiator, sport). Buckles, Velcro, or elastic provide adjustable fit. Overall height is minimal, exposing most of the foot. Distinguishing features include open-toe design, strap-based retention system, and minimal sole coverage.

Rectangular length of brightly colored fabric (approximately 1.0-1.5 meters wide and 1.5-2.5 meters long) wrapped around the lower body as a garment. Fabric is cotton, rayon, or silk with vibrant printed patterns including batik, ikat, plaid, or floral motifs. Edges may be hemmed or feature a decorative border (selendang). When worn, the fabric is wrapped around the waist and secured by tucking or knotting. Texture is smooth and lightweight with a flowing drape. Distinguishing features include rectangular fabric panel, vibrant printed patterns, and wrap-around garment configuration.

Single-reed woodwind instrument with a conical brass body, curved bell, and key mechanism. Body is lacquered brass (gold, silver, or black finish) with a characteristic J-shaped curve terminating in a flared bell. Length ranges from 60 cm (soprano) to 140 cm (baritone). Mouthpiece is detachable, made of hard rubber or metal, with a single cane reed secured by a ligature. Key system consists of 20-25 padded keys connected by rods and springs, operated by both hands. Neck cork connects the mouthpiece to the body. Distinguishing features include conical brass body, flared bell curve, single-reed mouthpiece, and complex key mechanism.

Protective sheath for a sword, dagger, or bayonet, constructed from leather, wood, or metal. Form is an elongated tapered tube matching the blade profile, 30-100 cm in length. Leather variants feature stitched seams, tooled decorative patterns, and a smooth or oiled finish. Metal scabbards (military) are steel or brass with a matte or polished surface. Suspension rings or loops are attached for belt or harness mounting. Throat (top opening) is reinforced with a metal band. Tip (bottom end) may feature a metal chape for protection. Distinguishing features include blade-matching tapered form, suspension mounting hardware, and protective enclosure design.

Mass-measuring instrument with a platform or surface for placing objects and a display showing weight. Bathroom scales are flat rectangular platforms (25-35 cm square, 3-5 cm thick) with a digital LCD or analog dial display on the top surface. Platform is tempered glass or plastic with a smooth finish. Kitchen scales feature a smaller platform (15-20 cm) with a raised digital display and tare function buttons. Mechanical variants use a spring mechanism with a dial indicator. Distinguishing features include flat weighing platform, weight display interface, and mass-measurement function.

Large motor vehicle designed for transporting children, characterized by a distinctive yellow (National School Bus Glossy Yellow) paint scheme with black lettering and striping. Body is a long rectangular box (8-12 meters) mounted on a truck chassis with a front engine hood (conventional) or flat front (transit-style). Features include multiple rows of high-backed bench seats, a wide entry door with folding steps, emergency exit windows, and flashing amber/red warning lights. Roof includes warning light bars and possibly air conditioning. Distinguishing features include standardized yellow color, multiple warning lights, high-back bench seating, and stop-arm signal.
